decision: Activate administration as ordinary delegable grants on the reserved mgmt_object:* resource-type (no separate admin subsystem) and ship a single new pure module src/core/scoped-admin.ts exporting validateAdminDelegation(adminCtx, child, oracle) — a thin composition that reuses T-0018 grant-lattice.ts verbatim along BOTH narrowing axes: (1) the resource/org-scope axis via validateNarrowing(adminGrant, childGrant, oracle) over the covering mgmt-grant, and (2) the org/admin-boundary axis via isNarrowerOrEqual(targetOrgScope, adminAssignmentOrgScope, oracle) using the existing AncestryOracle over hierarchy:org. Genesis-owner identity is an INJECTED boolean (adminCtx.isGenesisOwner): when true, the owner-minted write is accepted without a parent-subset check (the un-parented root, per T-0018 ADR genesis-owner identity); when false with no covering delegable mgmt-grant, the write is rejected with a distinct typed reason. The typed-rejection union AdminDelegationResult extends T-0018 NarrowingResult with admin-axis reasons (org_scope_widens, no_admin_authority). The module is pure/IO-free (oracle injected) — the DB write-path that calls it before INSERT is T-0030. Admin authority is seeded into the EXISTING grant + role_assignment tables (no new tenant table): one additive idempotent migration 026_genesis_owner_seed.sql wires the already-seeded grant-less tenant-owner role to delegable mgmt_object:{role,agent,process,grant} grants (CRUD + invoke for agent) scoped over the org forest-roots and one confirmed genesis assignment binding a seeded genesis-owner employee. grant-resolver.ts and grant-lattice.ts are NOT edited (additive-only).

rejected_alternatives.option: A separate mgmt_grant / admin_role / admin_acl table (a dedicated admin subsystem)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates the ratified no-second-authority-subsystem decision (NF-1, mirrors T-0018 AC-11). Admin is the PATTERN 'hold a delegable grant on mgmt_object:X', not a mechanism. mgmt_object:* is already reserved in the T-0018 ResourceType union; the grant/role/role_assignment spine already carries every field needed. A parallel store would be a divergent source of truth and a second narrowing path.

rejected_alternatives.option: A new ScopeElement kind or a parallel org-containment function for the admin/org axis
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates NF-2 (no new scope algebra). role_assignment.org_scope is already a grant-lattice ScopeElement of hierarchy:org, and isNarrowerOrEqual/AncestryOracle already decide org-subtree containment. A second algebra would risk divergence from the proven, adversarially-fuzzed lattice and break the single-source-of-truth for narrowing.

rejected_alternatives.option: Deriving 'is genesis owner' inside the lattice (e.g. a sentinel role slug or an owner-typed scope)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: T-0018 ADR fixes that the algebra relies ONLY on the owner's existence as an INJECTED boolean at the write path, never a lattice concern (keeps the algebra ignorant of 'owner', preserves closure/decidability). Deriving it inside would couple the pure algebra to seed identity and to DB lookups.

rejected_alternatives.option: Re-parent fin/cs/plat under a synthetic single tenant-root department to give the owner a single-node scope
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The dev org is a 3-root forest (fin/cs/plat, parent_id NULL — live-verified). Introducing a synthetic root requires EDITING migration 014's existing seeds (re-parenting) — forbidden (additive-only, AC-17). The lattice already supports a scope-SET over the three roots; an org-set {kind:set,members:[fin,cs,plat]} covers every subtree with zero DDL edit and no new algebra. Chosen instead.

rejected_alternatives.option: Ship the HTTP write-routes / grant-editor UI that call the checker before INSERT in T-0029
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Out of scope by the ratified backlog read: E3.4 (T-0030) IS the write-API/editor consumer. The day-1 ACs are provable WITHOUT an HTTP route (pure checker + adversarial fitness + live seed probe). Duplicating routes here is the wrong seam; the checker contract is frozen here for T-0030 to consume.

rejected_alternatives.option: Edit grant-resolver.ts to resolve mgmt_object handles on the read path
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Admin narrowing is a WRITE-path invariant (rejection before persistence). The read-path PDP (grant-resolver.ts) maps only application/registry/record handles; mgmt_object handles are not a read-path concern day-1. NF-4/AC-11 require grant-resolver.ts byte-for-byte unchanged.

contracts: export function validateAdminDelegation(admin: AdminContext, target: DelegationTarget, oracle: AncestryOracle): AdminDelegationResult — PURE, IO-free, never mutates/persists/reads IO; oracle injected.

Decision order (frozen for T-0030/T-0039): (1) if target.kind=='grant' and target.childGrant.scope is freeform: accept ONLY if admin.isGenesisOwner, and the seed/write-path forces delegable=false on it (reuses T-0018 FR-6); a non-owner freeform mint => free_form_non_delegable. (2) ORG-AXIS GATE (always, owner included is exempt): if NOT admin.isGenesisOwner and NOT isNarrowerOrEqual(target.targetOrgScope, admin.adminOrgScope, oracle) => org_scope_widens. (3) if admin.isGenesisOwner: accept (un-parented root; no parent-subset check). (4) else if admin.adminGrants has no delegable mgmt-grant covering target => no_admin_authority. (5) RESOURCE-AXIS GATE: for kind=='grant', return validateNarrowing(coveringAdminGrant, target.childGrant, oracle) (its reasons surface verbatim: scope_widens/facet_widens/constraint_widens/parent_non_delegable/free_form_non_delegable). For kind=='assignment', the org-axis gate (step 2) is the whole check (an assignment delegates org reach, not a resource grant).

Covering-grant selection: a covering admin grant is one in admin.adminGrants whose resourceType === target.childGrant.resourceType (same mgmt_object kind) AND whose operation === target.childGrant.operation AND delegable===true; validateNarrowing is run against it. If multiple cover, accept-if-ANY covers a valid narrowing (most-specific not required day-1).

validateAdminDelegation imports {Grant, ScopeElement, AncestryOracle, NarrowingResult, validateNarrowing, isNarrowerOrEqual} from ./grant-lattice.js and adds NO new ScopeElement kind and NO parallel containment function (NF-2/AC-9).

Frozen surfaces for siblings (NF-7): MGMT_OBJECT_KINDS, AdminContext.isGenesisOwner (injected boolean), AdminDelegationResult discriminated union — consumed by T-0030 (write-API/UI) and T-0039 (LLM-proposes). Names/shapes fixed here.

Audit obligation (AC-15): every mgmt-grant create/revoke call site (in T-0030, the write-API) MUST emit a T-0018 GrantAuditEvent carrying actor, subjectRoleId, capability {resourceType,operation,resourceFacet}, scope, and proposed_by/confirmed_by when present. T-0029 ships the obligation contract + a static lint stub; the call sites live in T-0030.

Seed migration: migrations/026_genesis_owner_seed.sql — additive (no edit to 001-021/022-025), idempotent (stable UUIDs + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), FK-ordered (employee -> role(existing) -> grant; employee -> assignment). Keeps T-0013 invariants vacuously (INSERT-only into existing FORCE-RLS tables; no new DDL). LIVE-VERIFIED on an isolated Postgres (001-021 + 026, double-run idempotent: 16 owner grants, 1 confirmed genesis assignment, stable counts).
